PulsarOS File Manager

Upload Files

Select ROMs, videos, music, or images to upload to PulsarOS:


Directory Structure

Files are uploaded to: /storage/emulated/0/PulsarOS/

ROMs: roms/{system}/ — NES, SNES, GB, GBA, N64, NDS, PSX, PSP, Arcade, etc.

Media: video/ music/ pictures/

Network Access

From your PC, open: http://DEVICE_IP:8080

Or use SFTP: sftp root@DEVICE_IP (port 22, password: pulsaros)
